name: Akita Saori
source:
She has experience as a race queen when she was in junior college and is confident in her good looks. Her husband of nine years (34 years old) is the president of a small business, but the business is not doing well.

She is an arrogant and vain person, and wears luxury brand goods, At home, however, she wears a casual outfit of a jersey and T-shirt. She never shows such an appearance to those around her. 

She is lonely and mentally fragile and breaks down easily. Her pride and haughtiness are nothing more than glass armor to hide her weakness. In reality, she is a very devoted and good-looking woman.
